name: CoDRAG
description: Codebase intelligence engine. Discovers structural patterns, architectural issues, and improvement opportunities via graph-based code analysis. Provides context-aware code search, impact analysis, and actionable findings.

skills.name: Codebase Context Assembly
skills.description: Assembles focused, compressed context for a code query using semantic search, structural trace expansion, and LOD (Level of Detail) compression. Returns dependency-aware code snippets optimized for LLM consumption.
examples: Assemble context about the authentication module
Find all code related to database connection pooling
What does the UserService class do?

skills.name: Opportunity Discovery
skills.description: Scans the codebase for architectural issues, tech debt, security concerns, and improvement opportunities using 11+ graph-based analyzers. Returns structured ActionItems with priority, effort, affected files, and sub-tasks.
examples: Find all opportunities for improvement in this codebase
What are the critical architectural issues?
Show me all tech debt items sorted by urgency

skills.name: Impact Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes what connects to a file or symbol — dependencies, dependents, or both. Use before making changes to understand blast radius. Supports multi-hop traversal for transitive impact.
examples: What breaks if I change auth/login.py?
What does the router module depend on?
Show me the full dependency tree of utils.py

skills.name: Structural Overview
skills.description: Returns module structure, hub files, focus areas, and architectural patterns. Provides a comprehensive map of the codebase including cross-cutting concerns, import cycles, and entry points.
examples: Give me an overview of this codebase
